purpose: Big-number card: large figure (h2), short label, optional descriptive line, with a mono index badge in the top-right corner.

figure.note: Measured numeric tokens such as "10PP" (1 word); a few giftcloud/codapay cards use a 4-6 word heading instead.

description.note: BODY COPY, budget from measured 11-28 words.

motion.delayRule: card i (1-based) has inline transitionDelay (i)*50ms, measured 50ms..300ms on cards
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (site has no prefers-reduced-motion handling): show cards at final opacity/position with no stagger delay.

responsive.grid: 1 col below 800px, md:grid-cols-2 (2 cards) or md:grid-cols-3 (3 cards)

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract

measuredFrom.quote: impact-figures-inner-card relative w-full rounded-md bg-offWhite text-charcoal p-5 h-full
